store.method: 30 fresh Node processes; unchanged 15 real parts; serial awaited append, fsync and atomic publication; OS cache not flushed; source buffers loaded before timed work; read verifies source hash in addition to NetworkStore verification; no slow-disk simulation

decision.R04: Superseded by explicit user acceptance on 2026-10-26: choose optimized Rust index/traversal/selection cache with measured RAM tradeoff; see rust-stage8-optimization-results.json.
decision.R06: Superseded on 2026-10-26: plan Rust migration of NetworkStore; filesystem/publication/retention in 08b, coordinator/read leases in 10, freshness/live ownership in 11. Not implemented yet.
decision.targetServerArchitecture: Rust for all technically portable server components; Node is temporary integration/fallback until acceptance.
